protocol: Operational aircraft test flight. The report describes a 30-minute oxygen prebreathe and approximately five minutes fully unpressurized near 24,900 ft. Complete individual oxygen delivery and cabin pressure histories are unavailable.
outcome_window: Distress was observed in flight around the transition to cabin repressurization. The fatal outcome occurred the next morning.
locator: Summary of Facts §§ 4(d), 4(e), 9(d)(3), and Statement of Opinion
note: The medical examiner attributed death to aerospace DCS. Published crew or passenger descriptions do not establish an at-risk cohort denominator.
